name: Stackfounder Vertical Card Slider
author: pratyushphp

sections.description:
Vertical Card Slider allows you to create smooth vertical scrolling image sliders with multiple columns and customizable settings.

Features:

  • Create unlimited sliders
  • Multiple scrolling columns
  • Upward and downward scrolling directions
  • Adjustable scrolling speed
  • Pause or slow down on hover
  • Custom link URL for each image
  • Responsive design
  • Simple shortcode integration
  • Lightweight and easy to use
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/stackfounder-vertical-card-slider directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress plugins screen.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress.
  3. Navigate to Vertical Card Slider in the WordPress admin menu.
  4. Create a new slider and add your images.
  5. Copy the generated shortcode and place it in any page, post, or widget.
sections.faq:
How do I display a slider?

Use the shortcode:

[sfvcs_vertical_card_slider id="123"]

Replace 123 with the slider ID shown in the admin area.

Can I add links to images?

Yes. Each image can have its own custom destination URL.

Is the plugin responsive?

Yes. The slider adapts to different screen sizes.

Can I control the scrolling speed?

Yes. You can adjust the speed and hover behavior from the slider settings.
